name: Markor
tagline: Edit Markdown notes and plain-text tasks on Android
description: Markor is an Android text editor for local Markdown, todo.txt, and other plain-text files. It provides formatting helpers, previews, quick notes, and task editing while keeping documents in ordinary filesystem folders. It works offline; synchronizing those folders across devices is handled by a separate sync application.
useCases: Write and preview Markdown notes on Android
Maintain todo.txt lists in portable text files
Edit documents that remain usable in other text editors
